column1: Preheat the oven to 475°F (246°C) and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment.
Pound the chicken to an even 3/4-inch thickness, arrange on the sheet and rub well with salt and pepper.
Whisk the honey, balsamic vinegar, and thyme together.
Brush a little of the glaze over each piece of chicken.
Roast 15–20 minutes until it reaches 165°F (74°C), brushing with more glaze twice along the way. Serve hot.
